# Tadaaa

> Tadaaa is an open-source (MIT), offline-first todo list app: tasks and tags live in the browser, with optional cloud sync, shared lists, webhooks, embeds and an MCP server so AI agents can read and manage a user's tasks. The hosted instance at app.tadaaa.space is a free demo.

Front: Lit / Concorde SPA at https://app.tadaaa.space. API + MCP: Symfony 8 / API Platform at https://api.tadaaa.space. UI in English and French.

## Docs

- [Homepage (markdown)](https://app.tadaaa.space/index.md): what Tadaaa does, features
- [Agent instructions](https://app.tadaaa.space/agents.md): when and how an agent should use Tadaaa
- [Agent authentication](https://app.tadaaa.space/auth.md): OAuth 2.1 (Claude.ai connector) or personal access token for the MCP server
- [Pricing](https://app.tadaaa.space/pricing.md): free demo, quotas
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/ladigitale/tadaaa): self-hosting, local API, deployment

## API

- [MCP server](https://api.tadaaa.space/mcp): streamable HTTP, authenticated (tools: list_todos, create_todo, update_todo, list_tags, list_datasets, webhooks, link detectors, artefacts)
- [MCP server card](https://app.tadaaa.space/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): machine-readable description of the MCP server
- [OAuth authorization server metadata](https://api.tadaaa.space/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): RFC 8414
- [OAuth protected resource metadata](https://api.tadaaa.space/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728
- [API catalog](https://app.tadaaa.space/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [Health check](https://api.tadaaa.space/api/health): public JSON status
